title: Ops-change edge-case check: any change to start/hook/broadcast/role mechanisms must pass a written 6-question reach test before ship (stale checkout? target session open? message length cap? who wakes it? dirty tree? first-reply proof). Add it to the Builder/Lead role files and to sync.py ship as a docs-checked line for paths in scripts/dev/role_*, mts_signal.py, hooks. DONE when: checklist file shipped, a test fails on a change touching those paths without the checklist line in the commit body, and the Lead role cites it
